angle: level, at her own eye height
start_frame: Close on her face from the curtain side: the bottle rising into the bottom of frame for the first cautious sip, the dim hall soft behind her.
end_frame: The same frame after three distinct tastings — sweet, then something savoury and wrong that stops her dead, then the laugh at herself — and the bottle coming down empty.
constraint_honoured: 'THREE distinct tastings in one shot without a cut' — one locked close, so all three reactions are carried by her face inside a single unbroken frame.
movement_note: Four seconds holding three separate beats leaves no room for a move, and the 50 mm is the only lens allowed this near a face.
